findings: Cross-check with the ChatGPT package: the raw OSM data is identical. Differences are interpretive only: Tatra 2 extent, confidence levels, Shino, Baby and Bombora.

Tatra 2 (high): extended to the Shino lower station, OSM ways 668794706 + 1018641392 joined (2282 m), after cross-check and user confirmation. The lower trunk is shared with Tatra 1 and already drawn on the site; branch 668794711 kept as an alternative.

Soliko 2 (medium, partial): only the upper 372 m (deleted way 158744056, ref 2B). Its first node is shared with Soliko 1 and it crosses the Shino lift about halfway up, as on the official map. No separate GPS corridor exists for the rest, so it was not extended.

Shino: the official map legend shows a dashed line as a Ski Way (connecting road), not a run, so the doc has kind ski-way. Best match is unnamed way 1259783832 (low), which was carved out of Tatra 1 in the 2024-03-10 cleanup. The western part toward Alpina has no OSM way.

Firni: OSM has one hybrid way 668794719 (named Kobi 1 in 2023, Frini since 2024, a misspelling of Firni). It was split where it crosses the gondola: nodes 0-9 (east side) as Firni 1, nodes 9-22 (west side) as Firni 2. Both are partial and low confidence. Kobi on the map is the name of the upper lift section, and the piste Kobi (668794718) already exists on the site above the Firni gondola.

Baby and Bombora (medium): centerlines of unnamed OSM ways 472374254 and 158817286, proposed by ChatGPT and confirmed by the user against the official map. They are centerlines, not area boundaries; the J-bar positions are not in OSM. Bombora's way is 50-110 m lower than the J-bar elevation listed by skiresort (unresolved).
GPS shows no unmapped run outside current and historical OSM lines. Only 4 recordings skied the Firni corridor at all.
The 2024-03-10 OSM cleanup (changeset 148478421) deleted Tatra 2, Soliko 2 and other pieces, probably why these runs are missing today.
Extra fields beyond the requested schema: historical (geometry from deleted OSM ways), alternatives (JSON string of candidate geometries), and kind value ski-way for Shino.
